initialFullVerify.scope: Before the final navigation fixes; subsequent Web typecheck, production build and affected browser cases passed. Existing test skips remain skips.

targetedRerun.reason: Agent edited the acceptance JSON while the full verification was running. The reproduction test correctly rejected the changed Git status. No production or test assertion was changed; the complete file passed once workspace state stayed fixed.

priorIntegrationAttempt.reason: Real xj-dev lifecycle tests detected stale dependency preparation after merging package manifests and started npm ci in the shared checkout while other tasks read those dependencies. Ran npm ci --include=dev before the next full attempt.

afterMainIntegration.scope: The last full command exited 1 only for the workspace-status mutation above; report the targeted rerun separately, not as a new exit-0 full command. Existing environment-gated skips remain skips.

hostedCI.scope: Commit 66e56b3 verified all final product/UI regression code. Later evidence commits record the physical IME result; a subsequent change stabilizes the inherited test-scheduler fixture only. The final PR Checks report the latest complete run.

failures: global worker budget 4 spans groups and exclusive files form barriers
real lifecycle tasks share the global budget; helper-linked outputs stay isolated

schedulerRegression.diagnosis: The fixture held workers for only 80ms and assumed four children would all start inside that interval. Slow CI child startup made the exact peak assertion timing-dependent.
schedulerRegression.fix: The first worker wave rendezvous on filesystem markers after recording each start. One first-wave process is deliberately delayed by 200ms. Existing exact-full-budget, maximum-budget, exclusive-barrier, output-isolation and logging assertions remain intact.
schedulerRegression.scope: Test fixture only; scheduler and product/UI source unchanged.

hostedRerun.scope: Complete verification after the inherited scheduler fixture repair at c4b0b80; all 10 verification jobs succeeded, release skipped by the PR condition. The supplemental Windows IME update changes documentation and evidence only.

targetedRerun.reason: Refresh restores a closed discussion panel; open it before checking the same accepted record. Business assertions retained.

previousProbeDiagnostics.earlierUnlockedAttempts: Native CGEvent inputs produced real composition events and exact Chinese text/reload in early runs, but the wrapper incorrectly asserted document.hasFocus rather than OS foreground. Later probe calibration runs had partial/literal text or foreground interruptions and are not accepted as a completed physical IME run.

systemPhysicalIme.probeCorrections: Use OS GetFrontProcess and the isolated Chrome process tree rather than document.hasFocus under Playwright focus emulation. Select the system source after bringing the real window forward and avoid repeatedly selecting an already active IME. Final run after unlocking passed all content, persistence and OS focus checks.

browserImeComposition.scope: Chrome composition protocol, not physical system IME

legacyUiRegression.fix: Core native selects explicitly support Home/End on all desktop platforms; preserve controlled snapshot/entry/operation state and existing run request checks. Monaco Tab-focus uses Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS and Ctrl+M elsewhere.
legacyUiRegression.scope: Headed installed Chrome on Apple Silicon Mac. Windows targeted legacy path not rerun.

physicalWindowsIme.scope: Installed Microsoft Pinyin via Win32 native virtual keys in headed installed Chrome; not a human hardware-keyboard observation.

screenshots.beforeCapture: Full-page captures with the same viewport; the previous long page exceeds viewport height.
